p: Institute Lane is right in the middle of Alfreton, an old market town in Derbyshire's Amber Valley, close to junction 28 of the M1. Admiral is 18+, strictly adults.

Alfreton is a great base for exploring. Crich Tramway Village, with its vintage trams running along a recreated street, is a short drive away, and the Midland Railway at Butterley near Ripley runs heritage train rides. Alfreton Park is a nice green spot in town. The Peak District is within easy reach too, if you fancy heading for the hills.
